quelle_de: Felder der Bildaufträge BRIEF-JON-001 bis -004 (Kapitelebene); Figuren wie im Buchbild (szenen-buch-jon).

figuren.FIG-JONA: Jonah: a man of about forty, short dark beard, dark hair, weather-worn face; a sea-blue robe (the only person in sea-blue), bare-headed.
figuren.FIG-GRUPPE-SEELEUTE: Sailors: three sturdy men of different ages in short undyed work tunics with headbands, bare arms.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-SCHIFF: A small wooden merchant ship of the 8th century BC with one mast.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-GROSSER-FISCH: A huge grey-blue fish, simple shape, no teeth shown, not a cartoon.
figuren.FIG-GRUPPE-MENGE: The people of Nineveh: men and women of different ages in rough dark sackcloth, dignified, never caricatured.
figuren.FIG-ROLLE-KOENIG: The king of Nineveh: an older bearded man with a simple gold crown, in sackcloth, his fine mantle laid aside.
figuren.FIG-ORT-NINIVE: Nineveh: long mud-brick walls with a gate and a small stepped tower, drawn with a few lines.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-RIZINUS-VERDORRT: A withered castor-oil plant with large hand-shaped leaves hanging down dry and brown.

1.note_de: Flucht, Sturm und Fisch in drei Feldern ([[JON.1.1-JON.1.17]]). Gott wird nicht gemalt; sein Handeln zeigt sich am Sturm und am Fisch.

felder.bild_en: Ancient Near East, 8th century BC. Jonah, a bearded man of about forty in a sea-blue robe, walks hurriedly down to a harbour, his back turned to a distant walled city on the left horizon (Nineveh, a few faint lines). On the right a small wooden merchant ship with one mast waits at a short quay. He carries a small bundle and looks away from the city. Wide shot, much empty paper.
felder.kern_en: Does a man in a sea-blue robe walk towards a ship, turning his back on a distant city?
felder.kern_de: Jona geht zum Schiff, weg von der Stadt

felder.bild_en: Ancient Near East, 8th century BC. A small wooden merchant ship with one mast tosses on high grey-blue storm waves. Three sailors in short work tunics with headbands lift Jonah, a bearded man in a sea-blue robe, over the side towards the sea; Jonah does not resist, his face calm. The ship is in the centre, the waves are broad loose washes. Medium-wide shot, upper third empty paper.
felder.kern_en: Do sailors on a ship in a storm lift or throw a man in a sea-blue robe over the side into the sea?
felder.kern_de: Die Seeleute werfen Jona ins Meer

felder.bild_en: Ancient Near East, 8th century BC. Under the calm sea surface a huge grey-blue fish swims through quiet water; inside its open mouth, small and clearly visible, a bearded man in a sea-blue robe disappears into it. Above, the sea is calm again, a far small ship on the horizon. Simple shapes, no teeth, not a cartoon.
felder.kern_en: Does a huge fish swallow a man in a sea-blue robe under water?

2.note_de: Gebet aus der Tiefe und Rettung ans Land ([[JON.2.1-JON.2.10]]). Gott wird nicht gemalt; dass er zum Fisch spricht, zeigt das zweite Feld nur an der Folge.

felder.bild_en: Ancient Near East, 8th century BC. Deep under the sea, among long strands of seaweed, the huge grey-blue fish floats in dim turquoise water. Inside the fish, shown as through a soft cut-away, Jonah in his sea-blue robe kneels with raised open hands and an upturned face, praying. Seaweed winds around. Medium shot.
felder.kern_en: Does a man in a sea-blue robe kneel and pray inside a large fish deep under water?
felder.kern_de: Jona betet im Bauch des Fisches

felder.bild_en: Ancient Near East, 8th century BC. At a sandy shore the huge grey-blue fish lies at the water's edge with open mouth; Jonah, in his wet sea-blue robe, crawls out onto dry sand on hands and knees, looking up. Calm turquoise sea behind, a strip of beach and a few stones. Wide shot.
felder.kern_en: Does a man in a sea-blue robe come out of a large fish onto a sandy shore?
felder.kern_de: Der Fisch speit Jona ans Land

3.note_de: Predigt, Umkehr und Verschonung Ninives ([[JON.3.1-JON.3.10]]). Dass Gott das Unheil reut, zeigt das dritte Feld an der verschonten, unversehrten Stadt; Gott selbst wird nicht gemalt.

felder.bild_en: Ancient Near East, 8th century BC. In a street of Nineveh between mud-brick walls Jonah, in his sea-blue robe, stands on a low step with one hand raised and calls out; townspeople in plain robes stop and listen, some alarmed. Medium-wide shot.
felder.kern_en: Does a man in a sea-blue robe call out to listening people in a city street?

felder.bild_en: Ancient Near East, 8th century BC. The people of Nineveh, men and women of different ages and children, sit and stand in rough dark sackcloth with bowed heads; in front of them the king, an older bearded man with a simple gold crown, sits in ashes in sackcloth, his fine mantle laid aside beside his empty throne. Medium-wide shot.
felder.kern_en: Do many people in dark sackcloth and a crowned king sitting in ashes show repentance?
felder.kern_de: Leute und König in Sacktuch und Asche

felder.bild_en: Ancient Near East, 8th century BC. Morning light over Nineveh: the city walls and the small stepped tower stand whole and undamaged; in front of the gate people in sackcloth look up, relieved, some embracing. A wide calm sky. Wide shot.
felder.kern_en: Does the city stand undamaged while relieved people in sackcloth look up?

4.note_de: Jonas Zorn, der verdorrte Rizinus und Gottes Frage ([[JON.4.1-JON.4.11]]). Gott wird nicht gemalt; das Buch endet mit einer offenen Frage, auch das Bild bleibt offen.

felder.bild_en: Ancient Near East, 8th century BC. On a dry hill east of the city, Jonah in his sea-blue robe stands with clenched fists and an angry, bitter face, looking up to the empty sky; far below, the city of Nineveh. Wide shot, much empty paper.
felder.kern_en: Does a man in a sea-blue robe stand angrily on a hill above a city, looking up?

felder.bild_en: Ancient Near East, 8th century BC. Jonah in his sea-blue robe sits exhausted under a simple booth of sticks; beside him a castor-oil plant with large hand-shaped leaves hangs withered and brown, a small worm at its stem. A glaring sun burns overhead, hot wind blows sand. He holds his head in his hands. Medium shot.
felder.kern_en: Does a man sit exhausted in the hot sun beside a withered plant with large leaves?
felder.kern_de: Der Rizinus verdorrt, Jona leidet unter der Sonne

felder.bild_en: Ancient Near East, 8th century BC. Jonah in his sea-blue robe sits beside the withered castor-oil plant on the hill and looks down at the great city of Nineveh below, full of people and many animals – cattle and sheep around the walls. His face is thoughtful and unresolved. Wide shot.
felder.kern_en: Does a man sit beside a withered plant and look down at a large city with people and animals?
felder.kern_de: Jona schaut auf die grosse Stadt mit Menschen und Vieh
